_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: the jump table of 124 slots ($C000-$C173). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C000: reset
regions.description: `JMP $FEDE`: The RESET vector: interrupts off, stack, three vblanks waited, memory cleared, the mapper checked, then the game (`$FEDE`).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C003: bank switch to A
regions.description: `JMP $D705`: Switch to bank A (`$04` shadow, `LDA/STA $FFF2,Y`). Y is preserved.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C006: far call
regions.description: `JMP $D76F`: The far-call trampoline: bank, target - 1 (low, high) follow in the instruction stream.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C009: flickering arrival
regions.description: `JMP $FD53`: The introduction shared by the ordinary enemies: drawn every second frame, no AI, no hits (`$FD53`).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C00C: add life
regions.description: `JMP $FD67`: Life `$48` += A, capped at `$FF` and at the maximum `$47`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C00F: rendering off
regions.description: `JMP $D4C1`: PPUCTRL bit 7 off (NMI off), PPUMASK `$FE` AND `$E7`, `$A3` := 0.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C012: rendering on
regions.description: `JMP $D4ED`: Commit the scroll (`$D68B`), rendering on (`$D4D5`: `$A3` := `$18`) and the NMI enabled.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C015: hide all sprites
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C018: clear a nametable
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C01B: reset the scroll
regions.description: `JMP $D4FD`: `$A6-$A9` := 0, the shadow registers `$FC`, `$FD` and `$A2` derived from them.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C01E: read the pads (stable)
regions.description: `JMP $D64C`: Reads the controllers until two reads agree: `$F5-$F8`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C021: wait Y frames
regions.description: `JMP $FFD1`: `$2B` := 0 and the frame sync (`$DA9A`) Y times.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C024: game-loop passes
regions.description: `JMP $FF8B`: Y passes of: frame sync, pads, the bank 6 object loop, HUD, decompressor.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C027: allocate an object slot
regions.description: `JMP $EA8C`: Highest free slot 23-5; reclaims `$0B-$0D`, or a type with bit 7 and `$0578` bit 1 clear; carry set = none.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C02A: kill score
regions.description: `JMP $DFB1`: Adds the points of the dead object (class `$E00D[type]`, or `$07D0` for types `$27`, `$2C`).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C02D: pad cell and demo input
regions.description: `JMP $DAE1`: Computes the pad cell `$32` (`$DB22[...]`); in a demo overwrites `$F5-$F8` from the pattern table.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C030: play sound A
regions.description: `JMP $D852`: Starts sound A (bank 0 `$8006`).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C033: score bonus award
regions.description: `JMP $DF8C`: Chips refilled, max life + 8, song `$31`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C036: queue a run
regions.description: `JMP $D5F8`: A PPU queue item of `$15` bytes (bit 7 = step 32) of tile `$14` at `$19:$18`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C039: reserve queue room
regions.description: `JMP $D6C0`: A = the item size including its 3-byte header; carry set = no room.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C03C: queue offset
regions.description: `JMP $D6E0`: Returns the offset of the reserved item in A.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C03F: commit a queue item
regions.description: `JMP $D6F7`: Adds the reserved size to the queue offset `$21`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C042: arm the decompressor
regions.description: `JMP $D7F9`: Block A of bank Y into CHR at `$19:$18`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C045: wait for the queue
regions.description: `JMP $D7C3`: Spins until the NMI has drained the queue / the decompressor is idle.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C048: remove an object
regions.description: `JMP $CCBF`: Clears object slot X.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C04B: reserve and wait
regions.description: `JMP $D6D3`: Reserve queue room, waiting for the NMI while there is none.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C04E: print a 16-bit number
regions.description: `JMP $E24B`: `$17:$16` as up to four digits at `$19:$18`, 9999 at most.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C051: print a 3-digit number
regions.description: `JMP $E1CD`: A as a blank-suppressed 3-digit number at `$19:$18`, committed.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C054: redraw a 2 x 2 tile cell
regions.description: `JMP $D865`: Tile A (a pattern index when its low bits are not 0) and attribute mask `$17` at x `$19`, y `$18`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C057: add to the score
regions.description: `JMP $DFBC`: A added to the score unless in a demo; kill counter `$40`; bonus check.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C05A: gun tier from the chips
regions.description: `JMP $E213`: `$3A` from the chip total, then the chip counter printed.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C05D: palette list walker
regions.description: `JMP $D92D`: Walks the palette list at `$18/$19` into `$0181+`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C060: picture on with sprite 0
regions.description: `JMP $EDE5`: Sprite 0 Y, DMC rate, picture on and `CLI`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C063: vblank sync and picture on
regions.description: `JMP $EDF4`: Wait for vblank, NMI on, two frames, rendering on.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C066: set item flag
regions.description: `JMP $EFE9`: Item flag n of the `$04A0` array.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C069: weapon sprite tiles, second part
regions.description: `JMP $F726`: The tail of the weapon-tile loader (`$F717`): the entry after its first block.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C06C: inline fill
regions.description: `JMP $D5CC`: Four inline bytes: count, PPU high, PPU low, value.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C06F: inline string
regions.description: `JMP $D576`: One inline PPU string item.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C072: print the uses left
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C075: weapon level
regions.description: `JMP $E498`: The 2-bit level of weapon A from `$04AC-$04AE`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C078: flag bit address
regions.description: `JMP $EFC7`: Bit number n to byte offset Y and mask A.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C07B: corridor cleared?
regions.description: `JMP $EFAC`: Carry clear = corridor A cleared.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C07E: blit a rectangle
regions.description: `JMP $D99C`: A `$15` x `$14` rectangle of tiles from `($16)` to the PPU address `$19:$18`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C081: move a PPU address
regions.description: `JMP $D9ED`: Adds `$15` columns and `$14` rows (signed) to `$19:$18`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C084: clear rows
regions.description: `JMP $E453`: Rows `$17` to `$16` - 1 with fill `$14`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C087: commit the scroll
regions.description: `JMP $E522`: Copy the scroll variables to the shadow registers.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C08A: key-door pictures
regions.description: `JMP $ED51`: Rebuild tiles `$00-$07` from the room record.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C08D: move and draw
regions.description: `JMP $CBE8`: Object X moved by its speeds and drawn; carry = off the screen.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C090: draw
regions.description: `JMP $CBFC`: Draw object X.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C093: draw a piece
regions.description: `JMP $CC34`: Metasprite A at (`$85`, `$84`).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C096: begin the frame sprites
regions.description: `JMP $CDB4`: Reset the sprite allocator.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C099: finish the frame sprites
regions.description: `JMP $CE88`: Hide the stale sprites.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C09C: y spring
regions.description: `JMP $CD12`: Accelerate y toward `$0668` by A/256 per frame.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C09F: x spring
regions.description: `JMP $CD46`: Accelerate x toward `$0680` by A/256 per frame.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0A2: clear the phase
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0A5: phase counter
regions.description: `JMP $CD7A`: `$0650` += A; on carry the phase `$0638` steps, wrapping at Y; returns Y = the phase.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0A8: art wait
regions.description: `JMP $CF5F`: Wait for the type's art block; returns for the caller while it is missing.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0AB: art wait, block A
regions.description: `JMP $CF68`: The same with an explicit block in A.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0AE: load the type stats
regions.description: `JMP $CFA0`: Flags, hit points, attack and `$0620` from the per-type tables.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0B1: hit box
regions.description: `JMP $D229`: The box of object X from its metasprite (y +- `$C201`, x +- `$C174`) into `$0710/$0728/$06E0/$06F8`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0B4: hit box, metasprite A
regions.description: `JMP $D22C`: The box of metasprite A at X's position.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0B7: hit box, y = A
regions.description: `JMP $D230`: The box with the y centre given in A.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0BA: hit box, y + A
regions.description: `JMP $D266`: The box with the y offset by A.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0BD: box and test, mask 4
regions.description: `JMP $D276`: Box, then the test against the player side (mask 4).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0C0: test, mask 4
regions.description: `JMP $D279`: The test only (box already set).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0C3: box and test: the ship only
regions.description: `JMP $D281`: Box, then the test against slot 0 only.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0C6: box and test, ordinary enemy
regions.description: `JMP $D294`: Box, then the mask `$30` test.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0C9: test, mask `$30`
regions.description: `JMP $D297`: The test only (box already set); carry = hit, `$6E` = the slot hit.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0CC: set the backdrop
regions.description: `JMP $D33F`: Backdrop colour A and a palette update.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0CF: box and test, fixed target
regions.description: `JMP $D29F`: Box, then the mask `$20` test.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0D2: hit consequences
regions.description: `JMP $D2BB`: The exchange of damage and the hit sound.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0D5: hit consequences, second entry
regions.description: `JMP $D2C5`: Entered after the test has been made.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0D8: hit consequences, boss rules
regions.description: `JMP $D39B`: The same exchange with the boss rules.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0DB: draw a single sprite
regions.description: `JMP $CF05`: One hardware sprite from `$84/$85/$86/$87`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0DE: fade in (no switch-on)
regions.description: `JMP $EDB7`: The palette fade toward `$04D0`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0E1: item flag set?
regions.description: `JMP $EFE0`: Carry clear = item flag n set.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0E4: wait a frame, read the pads
regions.description: `JMP $DA8B`: Returns the new presses in A (`$F5`).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0E7: PPU address one row down
regions.description: `JMP $DA1D`: `$19:$18` += `$20` with the nametable wrap.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0EA: random number
regions.description: `JMP $F9D1`: A, state `$2A`, stirred by the machine state.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0ED: fade out
regions.description: `JMP $EDD1`: Fade to black and rendering off.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0F0: random x at the top
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0F3: random place
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0F6: sine
regions.description: `JMP $F97E`: Sine of a 32-step angle.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0F9: cosine
regions.description: `JMP $F982`: Cosine of a 32-step angle.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0FC: aim at the player and set the velocity
regions.description: `JMP $F85D`: The direction to the player, then `$F8CE`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C0FF: direction to the player
regions.description: `JMP $F863`: Direction 0-15 from object X to slot 0.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C102: direction to velocity
regions.description: `JMP $F8CE`: Velocity from direction A and the speed class `$0698`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C105: make a child
regions.description: `JMP $FA4B`: Type A in slot Y at the position of object X.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C108: find a free slot
regions.description: `JMP $FA5B`: Slot 5-23 in Y; carry set = none.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C10B: divide
regions.description: `JMP $F9AE`: Y / A: quotient in A, remainder in Y.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C10E: divide, 16-bit
regions.description: `JMP $F9BA`: A:Y divided by `$10`: quotient in `$11`/A, remainder in Y.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C111: pixel to PPU address
regions.description: `JMP $FA6B`: Tile address and attribute offset of a pixel position.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C114: direction to slot Y
regions.description: `JMP $F865`: The aim code with the target slot given in Y (homing missiles use it).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C117: break a block
regions.description: `JMP $FA96`: A blast object, the cell redrawn, its class written.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C11A: redraw a cell
regions.description: `JMP $FAB7`: The tail of break-a-block: only the cell is redrawn.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C11D: write a cell class
regions.description: `JMP $FADE`: Class `$15` into the class map cell at x `$19`, y `$18`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C120: a random explosion
regions.description: `JMP $FB12`: One type-8 explosion near the point (`$19`, `$18`) in the box `$15` x `$14`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C123: negate the x speed
regions.description: `JMP $FB64`: x speed negated.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C126: negate the y speed
regions.description: `JMP $FB52`: y speed negated.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C129: the beam
regions.description: `JMP $FB76`: The beam machine (chain of pieces).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C12C: ride the scroll
regions.description: `JMP $FCD5`: y += `$B7` in a corridor; carry = off the bottom.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C12F: add chips
regions.description: `JMP $FCE7`: Chips += A, capped at the maximum, the counter redrawn.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C132: attack and shield stats
regions.description: `JMP $FD0E`: The ship's attack (`$05A8`) and hit points (`$0590`) from `$4A`, `$4B`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C135: weapon level
regions.description: `JMP $FD77`: The selected weapon's level into `$3D`, skipping unowned weapons.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C138: uses left
regions.description: `JMP $FDAA`: `$3E` := chips / `$45`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C13B: Hyper Laser attack
regions.description: `JMP $FDF8`: Overwrites the attack for weapon 9.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C13E: make a beam piece
regions.description: `JMP $FE3D`: A type-`$22` child with a style record from `$FE22`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C141: store the beam end
BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C144: re-aim countdown
regions.description: `JMP $FE63`: A = the interval; `$0680` counts the re-aims left; at 0 it re-aims at the player (`$F85D`), carry set.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C147: zero the velocity
regions.description: `JMP $FE79`: y and x speeds and fractions := 0.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C14A: stage step
regions.description: `JMP $E655`: One step of the stage engine.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C14D: restart the game
regions.description: `JMP $FF4A`: Stack reset, then the title (bank 0).

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C150: start the game
regions.description: `JMP $FF5D`: The game proper after the title.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C153: the HUD
regions.description: `JMP $E0F9`: The HUD pass.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C156: the decompressor
regions.description: `JMP $DB52`: One frame's share of the tile decompressor.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C159: remove objects 1-23
regions.description: `JMP $EA68`: Clear the object slots.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C15C: scroll speed ramp
regions.description: `JMP $E66A`: The scroll step and the speed ramp.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C15F: area music
regions.description: `JMP $FFDC`: Plays `$EF16[$50]`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C162: area scaling
regions.description: `JMP $FE88`: Attack and hit points scaled by the area.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C165: hit points x 16
regions.description: `JMP $D385`: Widens the hit points into `$0740`.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C168: spend the shot
regions.description: `JMP $FECC`: A shot on an immune part: the shot loses 21 hit points.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C16B: pads and pause
regions.description: `JMP $F493`: Pads, pause, status screen.

regions.name: BANK 7 JUMP TABLE, slot $C16E: palette fade step
regions.description: `JMP $D950`: One step of the fade.

regions.description: `JMP $D53F`: Like `$D576` with the PPU address in `$18/$19`.
